Specification: This module models a simple set-growing system together with a recursively defined cardinality function over finite subsets of integers. The key design idea is to encode recursion without a top-level RECURSIVE definition, by using a bounded CHOOSE over functions from SUBSET S to Int and constraining that function to satisfy the recursive cardinality equations. The specification initializes an empty integer set with size 0, then repeatedly adds a fresh integer from 1..10 while incrementing the tracked size, and states an invariant asserting that the tracked size equals the recursively defined cardinality of the current set.
IfThenElse: IF T = ({} <: {Int}) THEN f[T] = 0 ELSE \E t \in T: f[T] = 1 + f[T \\ {t}]
ChoiceExpr:
CHOOSE f \in [SUBSET S -> Int]:
      \A T \in SUBSET S:
        IF T = ({} <: {Int})
        THEN f[T] = 0
        ELSE \E t \in T:
              f[T] = 1 + f[T \\ {t}]
